ambassadors.title: FOA Ambassadors
ambassadors.intro: Represent Friends of Animals. Eligible adult members can apply; our community team reviews every application.
ambassadors.qualified: You meet the current eligibility requirements.
ambassadors.ineligible: You do not meet all the current eligibility requirements.

checks.membershipDays: Member for at least {days, number} days
checks.minimumAge: A recorded age of at least {years, number} years
checks.qualifyingMilestone: Earned at least one of these milestones: {milestones}

ambassadors.applicationHint: Your application will be sent to the community team for review. We will let you know their decision in your inbox.
ambassadors.apply: Apply to become an FOA Ambassador
ambassadors.approvedHint: Congratulations! You have earned the ambassador milestone on your timeline.

admin.title: Ambassador applications
admin.qualified: The applicant meets the current eligibility requirements.
admin.ineligible: The applicant does not meet all current eligibility requirements.
admin.intro: Review applications against the current settings. Approval records an earned ambassador milestone. Decline only with a reason the applicant can read privately.
admin.reasonHint: Up to 1,000 characters. Explain the decision respectfully to the applicant. This reason will appear in their private inbox.

outcome.submitted: Your application was sent to the community team.
outcome.approved: Application approved. The ambassador milestone was recorded.
outcome.declined: Application declined. The reason was recorded and the applicant will be notified.
outcome.ineligible: The applicant does not meet the current eligibility requirements. Review the checks before submitting an application or approval.
outcome.invalid_input: Enter a valid decline reason before saving the decision.
outcome.invalid_transition: This application has already been decided.
outcome.self_review: Another community manager must review your own application.
outcome.not_found: This application is no longer available.
outcome.forbidden: You do not have permission to make this decision.
